title.en: Where is the bass in the mix?

summary.en: Engineer muted the bass track. The bassist finished the gig without noticing.
summary.zh: 混音师把贝斯轨 Mute 了。贝斯手演完都没发现。

body.en:
Oldest band joke after drummer jokes: turn down the bass until it is a rumor. Early Beatles stereo oddities, metal walls of guitar, and indie "midrange forever" mixes all feed the meme.

Sometimes it is a bad mix. Sometimes the bass is felt more than heard. Either way, the bassist still has to carry the amp.
body.zh:
仅次于鼓手笑话的老梗：把贝斯推到像谣言。早期披头士奇怪立体声、金属吉他墙、indie「中频万岁」混音都给这梗加油。

有时真是烂混音。有时贝斯是「感觉到」多于「听到」。不管怎样，贝斯手还是得扛音箱。

note.en: Hard-panned early stereo: bass jokes write themselves.
note.zh: 早期硬分轨立体声：贝斯笑话自己长出来。

note.en: …And Justice / later loudness wars: bass as casualty in fan lore.
note.zh: …And Justice / 后期响度战争：粉丝传说里贝斯是伤亡名单。
